description: Search merchant catalogs by keywords or exact identifiers. Set affiliateLinkedOnly=true for recorded issued links. Use find_purchase_candidates with buyer destination and currency for a purchase route.

affiliateLinkedOnly.description: Only products with an official issued affiliate link; final approval can be pending.

availableOnly.description: If true, include only records marked available at source capture; excludes unknown.

currency.description: Native 3-letter currency code (e.g. KRW, USD) or all; explicit currency required for price filters and sorting.

destinationCountry.description: Shipping destination; market denotes merchant grouping, not buyer country

destinationRegion.description: Buyer state or region code (requires destinationCountry) for shipping policy assessment.

market.description: Merchant origin grouping relative to Korea (all, domestic, international); not buyer shipping country.

maxOptionPrice.description: Nonnegative ceiling on a dated exact Keychron option unit price. Requires optionQuery, sellerId keychron and USD; excludes unknown prices, shipping and tax. Zero candidate results include bounded optionBudgetEvidence for the same named option, preserving destination and buyer ceiling. Not current inventory, final total or buyer spending authorization.

maxPrice.description: Maximum native-currency advertised product price, excluding shipping and tax.

maxSnapshotAgeHours.description: Maximum elapsed hours since source capture; not a live check.

maxUnitPrice.description: Maximum native-currency price per referenceQuantity; requires currency, unit and referenceQuantity.

minPackageQuantity.description: Minimum recorded total package quantity in the selected unit.

optionQuery.description: Literal tokens must match the same captured option name. Requires sellerId and explicit currency. No product-price/unit ranking filters; revalidate exact option for budgets. Does not infer current stock.

optionQueryMode.description: Requires optionQuery. Default terms is literal-token discovery. exact matches the entire case-sensitive recorded option name, including spaces and punctuation; no trimming, normalization or variant substitution. terms allows up to100characters; exact allows up to200characters.

productCondition.description: Exact recorded merchant-declared product condition. Unknown or mixed/unclassified condition is excluded when supplied. Not independent inspection, grade equivalence, current availability or a selected-option guarantee.

productId.description: Exact case-sensitive Hadacart catalog product ID. Applied together with every other filter; an unknown ID or mismatch returns zero candidates without falling back to title search. Not a provider variant ID.

purchaseMode.description: Exact recorded advertised purchase mode. Unknown modes are excluded when supplied. Normal-purchase advertised price is not a rental/monthly quote or buyer-specific selected-option/final total.

query.description: Product title, brand, merchant/category keywords, or exact recorded ISBN13/SKU/catalog ID.

referenceQuantity.description: Positive reference quantity for unit pricing (e.g. 100 or 1).

sort.description: Sort order (default, priceAsc, priceDesc, unitPriceAsc); price/unit sort requires explicit currency.

unit.description: Quantity unit (sheet, mL, g, egg, pair, piece); requires referenceQuantity.

name: search_products
